journey.name: MOD-06: 浮动助理与屏幕圈选交互
journey.description: 验证用户在主界面唤起浮动助理面板，体验浮动悬浮球与卡片形态切换，展开浮动对话层，并能安全关闭或最小化浮动助理，保持底层应用几何连续性。

actions.action: Click the "浮动助理" action icon in top bar
Verify that the floating conversation panel appears over the current screen
Verify that the floating assistant input area is visible
Click the floating assistant close button
Verify that the floating conversation panel is dismissed
Verify that the user returns to the primary workbench screen
